headlines.title: שר הביטחון כ"ץ מזהיר את חמאס: "אם ייחטף חייל או אזרח ישראלי - העיר עזה כולה תפונה"
headlines.snippet: Defense Minister Yoav Gallant warned Hamas that if an Israeli soldier or civilian is abducted, the entire city of Gaza will be evacuated. He spoke at a memorial ceremony, emphasizing Israel's commitment to not retreating from its stance on Gaza until Hamas is removed and the area is demilitarized. Gallant also addressed the campaign against Iran, stating they had eliminated Khamenei and removed the nuclear threat, but warned that their work was not finished.

headlines.snippet: Netanel Shkaron, who was killed in a shooting attack near Neve Tzuf, was laid to rest at the cemetery in Ali Zahav. His 16-year-old son, who was with him during the attack, bid farewell, thanking his father for giving him life. His wife described him as an involved father, and his sister remembered him as pleasant, wise, and humble.

headlines.title: נתנאל שקרון הוא הנרצח בפיגוע במעיין בבנימין; המחבל נלכד בבית חולים ברמאללה
headlines.snippet: Netanel Shkaron was killed in an attack near a spring in Benjamin, and the perpetrator was apprehended in a Ramallah hospital. A gunman opened fire on people at the spring, then fled the scene. Shkaron, a father of six from Ali Zahav, was critically injured and later pronounced dead. Following a manhunt, soldiers arrested the attacker in a hospital after he was wounded during the pursuit. Another attacker attempting a ramming attack in the northern West Bank was killed shortly after.
